heroes.title: Russian Missiles Hit Kyiv's Bridges, Cutting Dnipro Crossings
heroes.body: Three strategic bridges across the Dnipro river struck in early morning raids; emergency services report heavy structural damage and transport disruptions.

heroes.title: Cyclone Akvan Slams Eastern India With 140 km/h Winds
heroes.body: Category 3 storm makes landfall near Puri, bringing torrential storm surges and widespread blackouts; 300,000 evacuated.

heroes.title: AI Stock Sell-Off Sinks Asian Tech Markets in Friday Rout
heroes.body: Heavy losses across Taiwan, South Korea, and Japan as major chipmakers and AI hardware suppliers suffer sharp valuation cuts.
